text: Add shared schemas and flattening for transient aim proposals
description: Implement a shared recursive AimProposal schema that rejects durable IDs, duplicate draft IDs, invalid weights, excessive size/depth, and unsupported statuses; expose deterministic flattening for later approval persistence.

reflections.context: Implement the first code milestone from the conversational aim-elicitation contract without introducing model calls or graph writes.
reflections.outcome: Added packages/shared/src/aim-proposal.ts with recursive schemas, limits, draft-ID safeguards, allowed proposal statuses, and deterministic flattening; exported it and added focused tests.
reflections.effectiveness: All 23 shared tests pass, including two new proposal tests; shared TypeScript build and git diff check pass.
reflections.lesson: Keep transient proposal identity structurally distinct from durable aim UUIDs, and make proposal size/depth/weight constraints shared so model, UI, and persistence boundaries cannot drift.

status.comment: Implemented and internally verified; awaiting Felix's acceptance.
